request.style: English, country ballad, warm male vocal, steel guitar, acoustic guitar, fiddle, piano, brushed drums, open and heartfelt, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My granddad kept a flock of sheep out past the county line
He knew them every one by name and they all knew his sign
He'd sleep across the gateway when the coyotes came around
And not a lamb was taken while he lay upon the ground

[Chorus]
I came that they may have life
And have it in abundance
I am the good shepherd
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep

[Verse]
I am the gate
Whoever enters through me will be saved
He will come in and go out and find pasture
The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy

[Chorus]
I came that they may have life
And have it in abundance
I am the good shepherd
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep

[Bridge]
I've wandered from the gateway and I've heard the stranger call
But I know my shepherd's voice now and I know he gave it all

[Outro]
I came that they may have life
And have it in abundance
